purpose: Defines the mutable persistence lifecycle for one immutable SimulationQuestion. Lifecycle state is never an input to seed derivation or simulation semantics.

question_content_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the immutable preregistered Question.

recorded_evidence.identity_rules: runs are exactly one executed Run for each preregistered Question DeckVersion and run_role; results are exactly one Result for each recorded Run; comparison binds exactly those two Runs and Results.

recording_identity_rules: Every recorded reference has exactly id, path, and content_fingerprint. Atomic transitions validate both lifecycle states and preserve every earlier reference exactly; a transition may add only the evidence allowed by its state edge.
persistence_boundary: The caller, outside the Simulation Engine, validates and atomically persists each lifecycle transition with its referenced evidence. Creation validation validates immutable semantics only; persistence validation requires the canonical lifecycle artifact.
seed_boundary: Lifecycle state, lifecycle timestamps, and lifecycle fingerprints are excluded from sim-seed-sha256-v2 inputs.
